up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5113380 (via the compound_records table). For each compound, return the molecule's ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Include all compounds even if some attributes are missing. Sort the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Return each compound only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5113380'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
